# ECN-2026-024 Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change

This engineering change modifies the documentation and maintenance baseline for the main ram bolt of the Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02). Background: during a planned disassembly for component inspection, maintenance technicians observed variable preload and fretting at the main ram bolt connection. Investigation confirmed that assembly practice varied between shifts and that existing maintenance procedures did not explicitly specify a final main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L4-HP02. The change establishes and documents the required main ram bolt torque and updates affected procedures and records to ensure repeatable assembly and to reduce the risk of loosening, fatigue damage, or misalignment of the ram assembly.

The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m.

Rationale

Establishing a single, documented torque value ensures consistent preload and clamp load across maintenance activities and between crews. Consistent preload reduces relative motion at the bolted joint, decreasing fretting wear and the likelihood of fatigue cracks initiating at the bolt or mating components. Explicit torque specification also supports traceability of assembly and simplifies troubleshooting when vibration or alignment anomalies occur. This change aligns the maintenance and operating documentation for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 to support safe, reliable operation during production and planned maintenance.

Affected items

- Maintenance procedure revisions: update the technical maintenance document referenced as MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 to include the specified main ram bolt torque and associated assembly notes.
- Standard operating procedures: update SOP-P1-L4-01 and SOP-P1-L4-05 to reference the new torque requirement where they direct ram removal, installation, or bolt inspection sequences.
- Maintenance records and checklists: update maintenance checklists and electronic work orders to include a field for recorded torque confirmation for the main ram bolt of EQ-P1-L4-HP02.
- Training and qualifications: maintenance technicians who perform ram assembly/disassembly on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 must be briefed on the revised torque requirement and the associated verification process.
- Spare parts handling: during reassembly after any replacement of ram-related components, the main ram bolt torque value must be applied and recorded per the revised MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.

Implementation

Scope: apply to all maintenance actions that require removal or reinstallation of the main ram bolt on EQ-P1-L4-HP02, and to routine inspections where bolt torque verification is specified.

Procedure updates
- MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2: add a new section immediately following the ram installation sequence titled "Main Ram Bolt Final Torque." This section will state the required torque value verbatim: 970 N·m. It will include the requirement to use a calibrated torque wrench and to apply torque in the specified bolt seating configuration described elsewhere in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2. Cross-reference SOP-P1-L4-01 and SOP-P1-L4-05 for safety and lockout procedures prior to assembly.
- SOP-P1-L4-01 and SOP-P1-L4-05: insert a single-line callout where ram work is invoked to ensure the technician verifies the main ram bolt torque per MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and documents the result on the work order.

Assembly and verification steps (summary)
- Prior to torque application, verify bolt and mating surfaces are clean and free of debris as described in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.
- Use a calibrated torque wrench appropriate for the required torque range, and verify calibration status against calibration records.
- Apply the final torque to the main ram bolt and record the measured torque value on the maintenance record.
- Perform a visual inspection for correct seating and apply any mechanical retention method called out in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.
- Document the technician’s name, tool identifier, and reference to the work order on the maintenance record.

Examples of acceptable records to retain
- Completed maintenance work order with explicit entry: "Main ram bolt torque applied per MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2: 970 N·m. Tool ID: [tool identifier]. Technician: [name]." (Bracketed items denote free-text fields that record personnel and tool identifiers.)
- Torque wrench calibration certificate or traceability record referenced by tool identifier used for the work.
- Photo record of the installed ram connection showing the final seating and any locking device applied, saved to the equipment maintenance folder for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.

Training and rollout
- Conduct a brief job safety and procedure briefing for maintenance staff assigned to EQ-P1-L4-HP02. The briefing will cover the torque requirement and verification steps, and direct staff to the updated MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, SOP-P1-L4-01, and SOP-P1-L4-05.
- Supervisors will ensure the first three maintenance actions performed against the revised procedure are co-signed by the supervisor to verify compliance and record retention.

Records to keep

Maintain the following documents in the equipment maintenance file for EQ-P1-L4-HP02:
- Updated MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 with the "Main Ram Bolt Final Torque" section.
- Work orders and checklists showing recorded application of 970 N·m to the main ram bolt.
- Torque tool calibration records referenced by tool identifier.
- Training acknowledgement records for personnel who received the briefing.
All records will be retained according to plant document control policy and made available for review during inspections and audits.

Approvals

This ECN requires approval by maintenance engineering, shop supervision, and quality assurance prior to issuing revised MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, SOP-P1-L4-01, and SOP-P1-L4-05. Approval signatures will be appended to this ECN and copies of the approved revision will be distributed to maintenance planners, supervisors, and the document control system.

Related documents

See the following documents for procedure details and safety steps:
- MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2
- SOP-P1-L4-01
- SOP-P1-L4-05

Implementation note: do not perform torque work on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 until revised MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, SOP-P1-L4-01, and SOP-P1-L4-05 have been issued and the assigned maintenance personnel have completed the briefing.
